notes.title: Calígine Prologue Demo is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p]You can now play the [b]prologue of Calígine[/b] for free. A short demo designed as a playable introduction to the world and mechanics of this graphic adventure.[/p][p]In this first segment, you’ll accompany [b]Fox[/b] during his routine before setting off on his next assignment. It’s a calm sequence, with no rush or surprises, that lets you explore his home, interact with a few elements, and get a feel for the game’s tone and pacing.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]What can you do in this demo?[/h3][list][*][p]Move freely around the house and get ready for the journey.[/p][/*][*][p]Interact with everyday objects and uncover environmental details.[/p][/*][*][p]Solve an optional puzzle hidden somewhere in the house.[/p][/*][*][p]Immerse yourself in the atmosphere before things get serious.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]It’s a short demo, around [b]10 minutes[/b], but it’s meant to help you get familiar with how the game works.[/p][p]Thanks for trying it out!
Looking forward to reading your thoughts and feedback.[/p][p]—[/p][p][i]Calígine[/i] is a traditional Point and Click graphic adventure focused on story, environment, and small details. This demo is just a brief introduction to what’s coming next.[/p]

notes.title: Main Storyline Completed
notes.notes:
The development of [i]Parámetro Zero: Calígine[/i] has reached a major milestone: the eighth and final chapter of the main storyline is now fully playable from start to finish. This means that the entire core narrative is in place, and while the game is still in development, the structure that holds its mysteries, puzzles, and revelations together is now complete and undergoing testing.

At this stage, some environments are still in their whiteboxing phase, serving as placeholders for the final detailed designs. The game currently includes only the essential elements necessary for progression—puzzles, dialogue, and key interactions—without additional visual polish or secondary content.

One of the areas now fully mapped out is the mine, a key environment in the final chapter. From its initial concept to its near-final version, this setting has undergone significant refinements. While not the focal point of the story’s resolution, it plays an important role in guiding the player toward the conclusion.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45416472/c461641315024ed4b8eb9d6770245f945de9233d.jpg[/img]

[b]What's Next?[/b]

With the main storyline in place, the next major focus will be the transversal secondary storyline spanning Chapters 5 through 8. Additionally, work will continue on finishing the prologue/demo, which will serve as an introduction to the world of Calígine.

Beyond these milestones, the final stretch of development will be about bringing [i]Risco de la Colina[/i] to life—populating it with characters, stories, and environmental details that will enhance its atmosphere and make it a truly immersive setting.

The journey is far from over, but this marks an exciting step forward. Stay tuned for more updates as [i]Parámetro Zero: Calígine[/i] continues to take shape.
